pages.title: Our approach
pages.body:
We make fewer things, more carefully.

Every piece in this collection is made in small batches by people we know by name. We do not run seasonal sales, because we do not build in the margin to discount later.

If something breaks, send it back. We will repair it at the cost of the materials and return it to you.

pages.title: Shipping & returns
pages.body:
Orders leave the studio within two working days.

UK delivery is £6, free over £120. European delivery is £14. Returns are accepted within 30 days in original condition.
